IIT Roorkee Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the IIT Roorkee recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the IIT Roorkee recruitment is Research Assistant. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Assistant post at IIT Roorkee.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Walk-in Interview date for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview date for the Research Assistant position is 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a PG / LLM degree. A PhD is preferred, and the area of interest should be IPR or related to the innovation ecosystem.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for the Research Assistant post for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The salary will be as per SPRIHA Guidelines, determined based on the candidate's qualification and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the location for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be held at the IIT Roorkee office, Roorkee, Uttarakhand, 247667.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant recruitment will be based on a Walk-in Interview.
